categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: consumer electronics and electric two-wheel vehicles. The consumer electronics segment includes manufacturing of display devices such as window protective screens, touch display modules, and precision structural components. The electric two-wheel vehicle segment focuses on the research, manufacturing, and sales of electric bicycles, electric light motorcycles, and electric motorcycles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Key technologies include advanced glass processing such as 2D, 2.5D, 3D curved glass, NCVM vacuum coating, laser engraving, and multi-layer composite coatings for protective screens. In touch display modules, the company employs high-precision transparent circuit etching, silver paste printing, FPC cable lamination, and Mini LED backlight technologies. Precision structural components utilize nano-injection molding, vacuum coating, metalization, and 3D printing. Electric two-wheel vehicles feature proprietary power systems, intelligent management systems, and advanced braking and anti-theft technologies. Production methods emphasize customization, automation, and lean manufacturing with dedicated production lines per product type.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves consumer electronics manufacturers producing smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices, automotive electronics, industrial control, education electronics, and medical devices. The electric two-wheel vehicle segment targets end consumers primarily through dealer networks, focusing on urban commuters, shared mobility, delivery services, and international export markets including Europe, Asia, and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and subsidiaries are located mainly in China, including Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Shenzhen. The company also exports electric two-wheel vehicles globally, with significant markets in Europe, Asia, and North America. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 77% of revenue, with exports comprising about 23%. The company is expanding production capacity and market presence in southern China and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain. It manufactures core components such as glass protective screens, touch modules, and precision structural parts (upstream/midstream), and also produces finished electric two-wheel vehicles (downstream). It integrates vertically from component manufacturing to final product assembly and sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating integration of consumer electronics components with electric vehicle products to form a vertically coordinated supply chain. R&D focuses on advanced display technologies (Mini LED, 3D curved glass), precision molding, intelligent vehicle systems, and new materials. The company emphasizes smart manufacturing, automation, and digital transformation. It aims to develop modular integrated components, enhance product differentiation, and expand into emerging markets such as smart vehicles and IoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized electronic components and finished electric two-wheel vehicles. The company uses a combination of direct sales and dealer distribution channels. Revenue streams include product sales of window protective screens, touch display modules, precision structural parts, and electric bicycles and motorcycles. Other income includes government subsidies, investment income, and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading supplier in the window protective screen and touch display module markets with proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. In the electric two-wheel vehicle industry, it competes with established domestic and international brands, leveraging its integration with the LIMA Group and advanced manufacturing capabilities. It aims to be a 'hidden champion' in niche segments of consumer electronics components and a major player in the electric two-wheel vehicle market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 40.88% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in electric two-wheel vehicles and precision components. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 619 million, reflecting increased impairment losses and non-operating expenses. The company has expanded its consolidated subsidiaries and production capacity, with significant investments in acquisitions and R&D. Cash flow from operations decreased by 45.43% compared to the prior year. The company is in a growth phase but faces profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced proprietary technologies such as multi-layer vacuum coatings, laser engraving, and integrated touch-display modules that offer high integration, durability, and aesthetic appeal. Its electric two-wheel vehicles feature innovative power systems, intelligent management, and safety technologies, providing high performance and reliability. The vertical integration from components to finished products enables cost control, customization, and rapid market response. The company also leverages industry cluster synergies and strong customer relationships to deliver comprehensive, high-value solutions.
